name: fx
description: The effects layer's CSS materials and its vocabulary (ADR 0022): glass (with edge, inner and specular), grain, sheen, glow, shimmer and ink, applied as a class on a component's ROOT through the typed fx() helper — <Card className={fx("glass", "edge")}> — and reaching the part they paint through data-slot, so no component grows a prop. One stylesheet per effect under styles/fx/, imported through fx.css after Tailwind and the theme, all inside `@layer fx` so an effect outranks a component's utilities while the app's unlayered CSS still outranks the effect. Glass paints --ui-bg-glass, a tint the resolver derives per brand and scheme so primary and muted ink clear AA over anything behind it (needs a theme emitted with the glass pair — theme zero's stylesheet carries it). The floor of every effect is the component: reduced transparency, forced colours and reduced motion hand each property back with revert-layer. EFFECTS is the single source of what exists, what each is for and where it applies; check:fx holds the stylesheets to it. The two shader effects, aurora and halo, are named here and shipped by the optional `shader` item. sweep(element) plays sheen's one-shot pass of light.
